answers.workaround: My current workaround is to create a .tsv file (tab delimited) and then rename it to .csv. This is somewhat cumbersome because Google Sheets (as recommended by the [importing_translations](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/assets_pipeline/importing_translations.html) page in the docs) exports tsv files by default with the extension .tsv, and then I have to shoehorn this into a .csv every time I make some changes.

title: Add `.tsv` as a valid file extension for CSV translations
